science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
summary: Kaio races to reinforce the lower pylons against the violent magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear ripping across the ferrofluid sea, using his natural intuition for environmental hazards before handing off the baton to Ryn.

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Brace the lower pylons before the ferrofluid shear wave snaps the foundation.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Adapt the colony to the exoplanet's unpredictable magnetosphere.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The Lower Pylons form a chaotic tangle of oxidized brass and conductive geodes, descending into the roiling abyss. Massive waves of spiky, black ferrofluid crash against the struts in slow-motion, driven by the violent magnetohydrodynamic shear. Flashes of bioluminescent spore-fog drift lazily between the high-voltage arcs, painting the cavernous shadows in eerie greens and purples.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Spiky black waves of ferrofluid, oxidized brass, and eerie green-purple bioluminescence.
sensory_palette.sound: The rhythmic, metallic crash of heavy fluid, accompanied by the high-pitched singing of stressed metal.
sensory_palette.smell: Rich, earthy fungal spores mixed with the sharp bite of ozone.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: A dense, humid cold that clings to the skin, punctuated by static shocks from the handrails.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: A faint, earthy grit that settles on the tongue.

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be wedged with extra scrap metal to distribute the kinetic load.
Can be struck to draw ambient static away from the main supports.
Can be cranked open to vent pressure and hide behind a cloud of spore fog.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: Destabilize the spire's magnetic containment field.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Pulsing erratic magnetic spikes that strip the copper grounding.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: A massive rogue crest of ferrofluid is rising, threatening to short the lower induction arrays.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: If ignored, the shear wave will breach the lower housing, triggering an explosive arc-flash.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: The massive rogue crest of ferrofluid threatens to short out the lower induction arrays and snap the foundation.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: The Stormbreaker Spire needs the lower pylons intact to handle the total energy load.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: The exoplanet's shifting magnetosphere is rejecting the Enclave's attempts to harvest energy.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: The strut buckles under the shear wave, plunging a section of the lower pylons into the ferrofluid and compromising the spire.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Kaio wedges the scrap metal in the wrong stress point, accelerating the collapse and dropping his toolkit into the sea.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: Kaio manages to brace the strut, but taking the brunt of the kinetic feedback shatters his climbing harness.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: Kaio perfectly distributes the load, stopping the strut from buckling against the massive shear wave.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Kaio braces the strut and notices a bioluminescent spore pattern on the metal that indicates a hidden thermal vent nearby.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Kaio tightens the final wedge, his hands slipping slightly on the damp, oxidized brass. He looks up through the chaotic tangle of struts. 'Ryn! I've braced the lower pylons against the shear, but the thermal load is spiking! What's the play for the induction arrays?'
